Q9029.reason: Hypotonic water absorbed across the bladder mucosa can cause fluid and electrolyte imbalance, which is why saline is used; water is not thicker than saline and does not uniquely bypass the catheter.

Q9030.reason: Under Restatement (Second), an intended beneficiary’s rights vest only on assent, reliance, or suit, and the parties modified the payee before the son learned of the contract.

Q9031.reason: A general ban on assigning the contract bars delegation of duties, not assignment of the right to payment, unless that payment right is specifically restricted.
